# Common actions

Which button, in which look, in which place, with which word. Cancel, Close, Reset, copy, edit, remove, the destructive tiers, and acting on many rows at once.

**Kind:** Pattern

**Storybook page:** `design-system/src/storybook-docs/patterns/CommonActions/CommonActions.mdx`

## Appearances

Primary, Default, Subtle, Warning, Danger, Discovery and AI. One Primary per area; one AI per region. The Button page holds every appearance and state; these are the places they go.

## Placement

The place sets the alignment. A page form's buttons start under the fields; a layer's end where the eye does.

- **In a page form.** Left-aligned under the fields, Primary first, Cancel Subtle beside it.
- **In a Modal.** Full bleed across the footer: Cancel (Default) left, Primary right, Close in the header. The footer is 48 high and never moves.
- **In a focused task.** The bottom bar: Cancel (Subtle) at the start, Back and Next at the end. Back is disabled on the first step.
- **In a card.** The main action is Subtle in the footer. A clickable card has no inner buttons; when in doubt, full-span inside tiles.

## Destructive tiers

Three tiers, picked by whether the change can be undone. No danger-outline combinations.

- **Active.** A change that can be undone: Cancel and the action in Primary.
- **Active with Danger.** A delete: the action takes the Danger appearance.
- **Danger, type the name.** A delete that cannot be undone: the caption asks for the name, and Danger enables once it matches.

## Key cases

## Usage

Use Common actions when a page needs a button and the choice is about the look, the place or the word. The appearance says how much the action matters; the place says what it belongs to; the word says what happens.

| Action | Appearance | Place | Word |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| The main action of an area | Primary, one per area | Last in its group | Verb and object: "Add students" |
| Another action in the area | Default | Before the Primary | Verb and object: "Reschedule session" |
| Leave without doing anything | Subtle; Default in a full-bleed footer | Left of the Primary | "Cancel"; a link is allowed |
| Close a layer | Icon button | Start of a focused title row; end of a Modal, Panel or Flag header | Named "Close" |
| Empty a menu's choices | Default, full bleed with Apply | The menu's footer, or the top of a filter side | "Reset" in a menu; "Reset filters" everywhere else |
| Empty one field | Icon button inside the field | End of the field | Named "Clear", "Clear search" |
| Copy a value | Icon button | Beside the value | Named "Copy"; "Copied" in a tooltip after |
| Change one value on a record | Inline edit on hover | On the value | Pencil named "Edit" |
| Change the whole record | Default, or Edit inside More | Title row or More menu | "Edit" |
| Take something out of a group | Default, or inside More | Row's More menu, or the bulk bar | "Remove from group" |
| Destroy something | Danger, after a confirm | A Modal's footer | "Delete note"; "Delete group" with the name typed when it cannot be undone |
| A change with a cost, not a delete | Warning | A Modal's footer | "Remove from this week" |
| The call to try something new | Discovery | Where the new thing starts | "Try the new schedule view" |
| The one AI action in a region | AI | With the region's actions | "Generate summary" |

## Alternatives

- For a set of choices the person picks between, use `RadioGroup`, not a row of buttons.
- For a menu of actions behind one trigger, use `DropdownMenu` from a More icon button.
- For a main action with variations, use `SplitButton`.
- For moving to another page, use `LinkButton`; a button acts on this page.
- For narrowing rows, follow Filtering: a filter is not an action.

## Content guidelines

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Verb and object: "Log session", "Add students", "Remove from group". | "Submit", "OK", "Yes", "Continue" with nothing after it. |
| "Cancel" to leave a form; "Close" to end a layer. | "Dismiss" on a form; "Cancel" on a Close icon. |
| "Reset" in a menu; "Reset filters" everywhere else. | "Clear all", "Clear filters", "Reset all". |
| "Delete" for something destroyed; "Remove" for something taken out of a group. | "Delete" for leaving a group; "Remove" for erasing a record. |
| Sentence case: "Mark attendance". | Title Case: "Mark Attendance". |

## Accessibility

- A button performs an action and a link navigates; the element gives the role. An icon-only button is an `IconButton` with a `label`: "Close", "Copy", "Edit", "More".
- A sending button sets `aria-busy` and keeps its label in the tree; only that button disables, and Cancel stays live.
- The Danger button in a type-the-name confirm is disabled until the name matches; the field caption carries the reason, never a tooltip.
- The bulk bar's count is a polite live region; the select-all checkbox reports its mixed state. Focus stays on the checkbox that was ticked.
- The focus ring takes `--ds-border-focused` on every appearance.

## Parts

| Part | Component | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Action | Button | The seven appearances; `isLoading` swaps the label for a spinner and keeps the width. |
| Icon action | Icon button | Close, Copy, Edit and More; its `label` names it. |
| Full-bleed footer | Modal footer | Composed from Button in fixed cells today. Planned as a footer prop on the Modal and the Panel. |
| Bulk bar | Section table head | The Dynamic table's head row, through `TableBulkActions`. |

## Related

- Forms: use when the buttons submit fields.
- Filtering: use for Reset and Apply inside a filter menu.
- Modal: use for the confirm a destructive action raises.
- Patterns: use when you need Disabled for an action that cannot run yet.

## Motion

Common actions reads these motion tokens and no literal duration or curve.

| Event | Transition | Tokens | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| selection | Update a value or state | `--ds-motion-appearance-fast` | Ticking a row turns the table's head row into the bulk bar: the labels cross-fade, same row, same height, nothing slides. The selected rows take the selected fill and the count fades to each new value. Clearing the rows, or the select-all checkbox, reverses it. The view bar above never moves. |
| confirm | Open and close an overlay | `--ds-motion-appearance-fast` | A destructive action opens a Modal. Confirm fades it and carries on: the row's status changes color, and a Flag confirms. |
| cancel | Open and close an overlay | `--ds-motion-spatial-fast` · `--ds-motion-appearance-fast` | Cancel reverses the Modal's entrance one speed faster. |
| undo | Add or remove an item | `--ds-motion-spatial-fast` · `--ds-motion-appearance-fast` | Keep and Undo sit beside the change, tinted, until the person moves on. Undo reverses the Add or remove that made the change. |

## Best practices

### Give an area one Primary button. {#give-an-area-one-primary-button}

**Checked:** Automatic

The Primary is the main call to action or a form's submit. A second main action is Default beside it; a second Primary makes neither read as the next step. The AI appearance follows the same rule, one per region, and only for an action that calls AI.

Do: One Primary, with the other action Default beside it.
Don't: Two Primary buttons in one row: neither reads as the next step.

### Left-align buttons under a page form and right-align them in a Modal, a focused task or steps. {#left-align-buttons-under-a-page-form-and-right-align-them-in-a-modal-a-focused-task-or-steps}

**Checked:** Automatic

On a page the Primary comes first, read in the same direction as the fields. In a layer the Primary is furthest right, where the eye ends. Stacked buttons put the Primary on top. Never top-aligned.

Do: Primary first, then Cancel, left-aligned under the fields.
Don't: The buttons at the far end of the page, away from the fields, with the Primary last.

### Go full bleed in a Modal footer and keep it 48 high. {#go-full-bleed-in-a-modal-footer-and-keep-it-48-high}

**Checked:** Automatic

Buttons fill the footer, each a fraction of its width with a hairline between, losing their inner corners. One button takes the whole footer. The footer is the same 32 button plus 16 bottom pad a regular footer takes, so nothing inside changes its size. A Panel's editing footer and a card form's footer go full bleed the same way.

Do: Two buttons filling the footer edge to edge.
Don't: Small buttons inset at the end, with spare footer around them.

### Keep the footer where it is. {#keep-the-footer-where-it-is}

**Checked:** Automatic

Header and footer stay pinned while the body scrolls. A blocked submit, a server message and a sending button change the body or a button, never the footer's size or place. A sending button swaps its label for a spinner in place and keeps its width; only that button disables, and Cancel stays live.

### Keep Close an icon button, separate from Cancel. {#keep-close-an-icon-button-separate-from-cancel}

**Checked:** Automatic

Close ends a layer and lives in its header, or at the start of a focused title row. Cancel leaves a form without saving and lives with the form's buttons. Neither stands in for the other; a Modal has both.

### Make Cancel Subtle beside a Primary and Default in a full-bleed footer. {#make-cancel-subtle-beside-a-primary-and-default-in-a-full-bleed-footer}

**Checked:** Automatic

Beside a Primary it is already clear the row is interactive, so Cancel steps back. In a full-bleed footer every cell is a button, so Cancel takes the Default fill to read as one. Cancel may be a link where a button would compete.

### Say Reset in a menu and Reset filters everywhere else. {#say-reset-in-a-menu-and-reset-filters-everywhere-else}

**Checked:** Automatic

The words and where they sit: Filtering › Say Reset in a menu and Reset filters everywhere else.

### Confirm a copy with a Copied tooltip, not a Flag. {#confirm-a-copy-with-a-copied-tooltip-not-a-flag}

**Checked:** Automatic

The tooltip opens on the Copy button the moment the value is on the clipboard and leaves on its own. Flags stay for events that happened somewhere else.

### Edit one value inline and the whole record from More. {#edit-one-value-inline-and-the-whole-record-from-more}

**Checked:** Review

A value read far more than changed takes `InlineEdit`: a pencil on hover and focus, saved on its own. The record's More menu includes Edit, which opens the form host the Forms pattern picks. Never put inline edits inside a form that has its own Save.

### Name a destructive action by its tier. {#name-a-destructive-action-by-its-tier}

**Checked:** Review

Active: it can be undone, Cancel and a Primary. Active with Danger: a delete, the action in Danger. Danger with the name typed: a delete that cannot be undone, the field caption asks for the name and the Danger button enables once it matches, with no tooltip. Remove, which takes something out of a group it can return to, is Default, not Danger. The Modal that raises the confirm: Modal.

### Turn the head row into the bulk bar when rows are selected. {#turn-the-head-row-into-the-bulk-bar-when-rows-are-selected}

**Checked:** Automatic

The bar and its words: Section › Turn the head row into the bulk bar when rows are selected.

### Keep a card's main action Subtle in its footer. {#keep-a-card-s-main-action-subtle-in-its-footer}

**Checked:** Review

A clickable card has no inner buttons; the whole card is the action. When a card does carry a button, it is Subtle in the footer, and inside tiles it spans the full width when in doubt.
